item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-Live-Transcribe and Batch GPT-Transcribe Models
item.description: OpenAI releases two dedicated speech-to-text API models: low-latency GPT-Live-Transcribe ($0.017/min) and 34x-realtime batch GPT-Transcribe ($4.50 per 1,000 mins).

item.title: batisay: Free On-Device Korean Speech-to-Text Tuned for Apple Silicon
item.description: batisay fine-tunes Whisper large-v3-turbo on 4,300 hours of conversational Korean and runs locally on MacBooks via whisper.cpp and Apple Silicon Metal acceleration.

item.title: Mac Whisper: On-Device Push-to-Talk Voice Dictation via the Fn Key
item.description: Mac Whisper is an open-source macOS dictation tool triggered by holding the Fn key, with version 0.0.4 cutting CPU overhead and adding optional LLM cleanup.
